description:
Consult sales, inventory, orders and accounts receivable for your restaurant, burger shop or food factory in Pedido Certo. Analyze monthly product sales, low-stock ingredients, expiring lots and recorded order history. Factories can also consult B2B orders and production data.

Sign in with your own account and authorize a business unit. Access starts read-only; financial queries and changes require additional consent inside Pedido Certo. Financial data is limited to receivables and billing information available in the system. The connector does not provide accounts payable, bank statements, bank balances or profit.
